assessment: The authors present a rigorous and valuable study in which they identify the role of the conserved bacterial enhancer binding protein (bEBP) SypG in regulation of the Qrr1 small RNA, a key regulator of Vibrio fischeri bioluminescence production and squid colonization. The research design and methods were convincing and thorough, leading to compelling conclusions that are broadly relevant to both the quorum sensing and Vibrio-squid symbiosis fields.
